limitations: One ordered pair, no reverse repeat; cache/order/host drift remain. No four-node/150-step score. Partition method can change floating-point order and Cd; do not impose an invented universal accuracy tolerance. Affinity probe is outside solver timing, not solver migration or actual page placement. Hardware bandwidth/cache/MPI counters and power not collected. GNU time wraps PALS launcher.
